availabilityAudit.externalStandaloneOnly: retains only registry handlers, excluding every backend tool, every name in SESSION_TOOLS_REQUIRING_HOST_CALLBACK, and every name in SESSION_TOOLS_WITHHELD_FOR_NATIVE_EQUIVALENT
availabilityAudit.browserProjection: PiAgent registers mcp__session__browser_tool only when getBrowserToolEnabled(); disabled projection filters it before register_tools
availabilityAudit.webTools: web_search and web_fetch are always constructed by ensureSession; search provider choice is dynamic per call
availabilityAudit.orchestratorTools: subagent, review, get_subagent_result, steer_subagent, stopTask, workflow and ask_user are always constructed by ensureSession; all but subagent, ask_user and review are PI_DEFERRABLE_BUILTIN_BINDINGS, so with deferral on those are reached through mcp__tool_search — review is upfront so /code-review runs in its own turn (F1.728)
availabilityAudit.deferredMcp: enabled when deferredMcpToolLoading=true (the shipped default) and any candidate exists: MCP tools not alwaysLoad, the eight PI_DEFERRABLE_BUILTIN_BINDINGS and the session tools outside PI_UPFRONT_SESSION_BINDINGS (which keeps ReportFindings upfront for the same reason, F1.728); NESSY_ENABLE_TOOL_SEARCH never/always/auto[:N] overrides it and an uncached MCP source forces it on (resolveDeferredMcpToolLoading); search/load remain callable and exact accepted hidden tools register into the live session, callable from the next model call of the same request (F1.803)
availabilityAudit.dynamicMcp: descriptor set is owned by the leased EffectiveCapabilitySnapshot/AgentRuntimeView

dispatchContract.ordinaryToolCallHookLimitation: Exact lookup and the unknown-name error result occur before Pi beforeToolCall and before any matched execute function. Nessy hooks wrap only an already matched execute function, so an ordinary tool_call hook cannot create or rename an unknown tool.
dispatchContract.requiredAliasPlacement: Known historical tool names — the pre-unification snake_case session piNames, and the two native host spellings — normalize only in bounded persisted Pi SDK transcript ingress; live V2 registration and dispatch accept current exact piName only.
